visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with light brown hair in a white fuzzy sweater is seated at a white table in a cozy, brightly lit indoor room. She poses playfully, touching her face and making peace signs, while various packaged food items and a large cup with a Snoopy-themed straw are laid out before her. (2) The scene transitions into a photography tutorial; the woman lies her head on the table next to the food, looking into the camera from a 45-degree angle. Yellow and white text overlays appear on the screen. (3) A man in a brown sweatshirt and cap is seen standing on a chair, holding a smartphone to take a top-down shot of the woman, who holds a Snoopy-branded box while seated on the floor. (4) The woman holds up a purple cup with a cartoon straw, posing for the camera with her hand to her cheek. (5) The woman showcases a wide array of 7-Eleven collaboration products, including pasta bowls, rice balls, and donuts with Snoopy illustrations. She is seen eating the food, showing close-ups of the textures, and displaying sets of colorful Snoopy stickers. (6) The video concludes with her surrounded by all the featured products, smiling broadly and gesturing towards the items in a celebratory manner.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, high-energy electronic pop track. A lively female voice speaks quickly, followed by a sharp 'camera shutter' SFX. (2) As the narration transitions to photography tips, a 'whoosh' transition sound is heard, punctuating the change in visual instruction. (3) A series of 'pop' and 'ding' SFX accompany the appearance of text overlays, synchronized with the rhythmic beat of the BGM. (4) The female narrator's tone becomes more descriptive and persuasive as she begins listing specific food products, with the music maintaining a steady, upbeat tempo. (5) Subtle 'crunch' or 'slurp' sounds are occasionally mixed in during eating close-ups, though the voice and BGM remain dominant. (6) A final 'stinger' SFX marks the end of the video as the narrator gives a concluding enthusiastic call to action.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the limited edition 7-Eleven x Snoopy 75th Anniversary collaboration products, including various meals, snacks, and collectible items, by showcasing them in a trendy, lifestyle-oriented format.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of brand names, display of logos, price points, and promotional periods for 7-Eleven products.
